violations.why: The ISR can preempt between the read and the write in *ptr_var = *ptr_var + 1, so it may overwrite v_amber before the original write stores the incremented value.
The ISR can write v_amber after fn_raptor sets it but before fn_fjord reads it, causing fn_fjord to read the ISR‑written value instead of the one set by fn_raptor.
